description: This file defines a PHP class 'Theme' inside the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension', which manages theme extensions within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing themes, installing, and uninstalling themes, with interactions involving configuration, permissions, and file system operations.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing theme extensions within OpenCart's admin panel, providing functionalities to list, install, and uninstall themes, with permission checks and filesystem operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets the output response to the list of themes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data regarding available and installed theme extensions for display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing a new theme extension, including permission checks, language setup, registration of controllers/models, and updating extension status.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles removing an installed theme extension, including permission checks, and invoking the uninstall process for the extension.
